statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry whose affected product is Microsoft SharePoint, with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if a fetch of the CISA KEV JSON at the deadline shows any Microsoft SharePoint entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog fetched at the deadline contains no Microsoft SharePoint entry with a dateAdded value inside the 2026-08-14 to 2026-09-30 window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The White House publicly names a specific individual as the next White House press secretary, acting or permanent, between 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if AP or Reuters carries a White House announcement, dated between 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-30, naming a specific successor as press secretary; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: As of the deadline, no White House announcement dated inside the window names any specific individual as the next press secretary.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The Reform UK candidate is declared the winner of the Clacton by-election held on 2026-08-13.
resolution: TRUE if the returning officer's declared result, as carried by BBC or PA Media, names the Reform UK candidate as the winner; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The officially declared Clacton result names a candidate of any other party, or an independent, as the winner.

statement: At least one reactor unit at Romania's Cernavoda nuclear plant records nonzero electricity output on the ENTSO-E transparency platform on at least one day between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if ENTSO-E actual generation per generation unit shows output above 0 MW for any Cernavoda unit on any date between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: ENTSO-E per-unit generation data show zero output from every Cernavoda unit on every day of the 2026-08-14 to 2026-09-30 window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

statement: The United States and Iran both publicly confirm a ceasefire or framework agreement between them, with confirmations dated between 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if statements from both the US and Iranian governments confirming a ceasefire or framework agreement, each carried by AP, Reuters, or AFP, are dated between 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: By the deadline, at least one of the two governments has issued no confirmation of any such agreement dated inside the window.

statement: The OHCHR human rights monitoring mission monthly update covering August 2026 reports a Ukraine civilian-killed total lower than the July 2026 total it states.
resolution: TRUE if the published OHCHR HRMMU update covering August 2026 states an August civilian-killed total strictly below its stated July 2026 total; FALSE if equal, higher, or no update is published by the deadline.
failure_condition: The August update states a civilian-killed total equal to or above its July figure, or no update covering August 2026 exists by the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
